Scott Cunningham, [*Causal Inference: The Mixtape*](https://mixtape-1ed.netlify.app/) (Yale University Press, 2021). The examples are estimated in [CausalPy](https://causalpy.readthedocs.io).

::: {.callout-note}
## Unofficial

This site is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or authorized by Scott Cunningham, Baylor University, Yale University Press, or PyMC Labs. It is a translation of the analyses, not a copy of the book. Credit, dataset citations, and the upstream license notice are on the [attribution page](attribution.qmd).
:::

## What will not match

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-sm-4}
::: {.home-fact}
**Bayesian, not OLS.** Estimates are PyMC posteriors unless a section says otherwise. Numbers will not match the book's OLS tables exactly. Each chapter records where they differ and why.
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-sm-4}
::: {.home-fact}
**First edition only.** This site does not cover the second edition, [*Causal Inference: The Remix*](https://mixtape.scunning.com/).
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-sm-4}
::: {.home-fact}
**Recomputed, not copied.** Plots are new. These pages do not reproduce the book's figures or the identification narrative.
:::
:::

:::
